title: Musicians who came out of Jones' Home
summary: French says many players came from the Colored Waif's Home, including Armstrong, Rena and Kid Shots.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Now, he know all them fellas down there. They been down there. They been down there. They come out Jones' home out there. Like Lewis Armstrong. They all come out there. Renny come out there. Joe come out there. Lewis come out there. Shots too, huh? I know Black Ben didn't come out of Jones' home. I believe he did. A whole bunch of them come out.
Yeah, I think he did too, didn't he?
I believe so too. All come out there.
